The things she said I "have to" see, transcribed from a napkin before I
lost it. Reporting back is apparently expected.

- [ ] *Come and See*
- [ ] the Jodorowsky one
- [ ] *Possession* (1981)
- [ ] a punk documentary whose name I didn't write down and now regret

summary: Films Sid insists on, transcribed from a napkin before it was lost
title: Sid's list
